description: Get the full description and application URL for a job returned by recommend_jobs or search_jobs.

id.description: Stable job id returned by search_jobs or recommend_jobs (jobId is accepted too)

name: get_job

job.description: The full job, including its description and the employer's application URL

age.description: Bucketed posting age; undated means the board gave no date, not that the role is fresh

cities.description: Canonical Indian cities the location names, such as Bengaluru for Bangalore

eligibleCountries.description: Two-letter codes the role is open to

experience.description: Years the posting itself states as { min, max }; null when it states none, absent when the description was not read

id.description: Stable id to pass to get_job, analyze_job_fit or optimize_resume

role.description: Role family read from the title, such as backend, data-science or sales; other when the title is not plain about it

seniority.description: From the title, else from the posting's stated experience; absent when neither says

states.description: Indian states those cities are in, or that the location names

updatedAt.description: When the board says the role was posted or last updated; absent when the board states none

url.description: The employer's own posting, which is where an application is made

title: Get job details
